credits.title: A Free Man
credits.overview: To make a quick buck, a young Quebec worker arrives in Fort McMurray. Obsessed with his ambitions, he finds himself in a difficult situation following a workplace accident.

credits.title: Merry Little Mystery
credits.overview: Natasha Maxwell spends the holidays at her grandparent’s house in the tiny town of Roundtop, where she grew up. She happily takes over from her grandfather as the small town’s benevolent Secret Santa, covertly delivering gifts to deserving and grateful citizens. credits.title: Holiday Mismatch
credits.overview: New retiree Barb joins a Holiday Committee but clashes with long standing member Kath. When they realize their kids have started dating, they conspire to break up the happy couple.

credits.title: Balance
credits.overview: A man, alone in a bathroom, gets ready to go out. He's stopped in his tracks when he trips on his bathroom scale. Desperate to rid his body's imperfections, he decides to weigh himself, to devastating consequences.
